data.one_liner: Print receipts using an ESC/POS thermal WiFi or Ethernet printer in Flutter and Dart projects.
data.what_it_does: Allows connecting to thermal printers via IP addresses and ports to print styled text, images, barcodes, and manage printer cutting and cash drawers.
use_when: You need to print receipts or tickets to a network-connected ESC/POS thermal printer.
You are working on a Flutter or pure Dart project requiring local receipt printing over WiFi/Ethernet.
avoid_when: You are trying to print using Bluetooth printers (use esc_pos_bluetooth instead).
You need complex document layout generation like multi-page PDF generation.
strengths: Simple API to connect via host and port to thermal printers.
Supports text styling, code tables, images, and receipt cutting out of the box.
weaknesses: Bluetooth support was moved to a separate library.
Does not include built-in network scanning (requires external packages like ping_discover_network).
